snippet.title: Killbot General - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the crazy, irreverent world of Killbot General! An upcoming real-time tactics game featuring a dynamic story campaign (co-op or solo), and a focus on strategy, not micromanagement or speed ("actions per minute").

Create a customized cause and lead it to glory as its hero Killbot General! Simple yet deep, designed from the ground up to be controller-friendly.

Check out our other videos, come say "hi" on our Discord, and join our upcoming playtests.
